what_it_enables: Mathematical saturation, continuum ranges, zero-divisor safety, and Tri-Vital models
Core damage, mitigation, hit resolution, crits, and exploration check formulas
The 8 Exploration stats (STR, DEX, VIT, INT, WIS, CHA, PER, REP) paired with combat stats
Sub-surface combat parameters: Accuracy, Evasion, Poise / Flank Vigor, ZOC, Threat, and Facing
The 6 Primal and 7 Compound Elements including Statera (Lux + Tenebris harmonic synthesis)
Dual-accumulator Conscience Ledger distinguishing active Statera from passive bystander inertia
Multi-tier frame pacing: 30 FPS (Low-Spec), 60 FPS (Standard), and 120 FPS (High-Refresh)
Lag spike defense, delta clamping, and fixed simulation timestep decoupling physics from framerate
Diegetic calendar tracking diurnal day/night cycles and nocturnal Dreamscape portals
Dialogue engine formatting, quest states, puzzle verbs, and canonical Statera stance lexicon
The hotpatch incubator registry tracking emerging mechanics, prototypes, and future design hooks
Zero dynamic heap allocation (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP) foundation for all higher simulation layers
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across Layer 0 utilities (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All registered profile paths resolvable via fs_resolve_data_path()
All timing profiles must use POSIX.1b CLOCK_MONOTONIC timing source
